'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]]'s [[Royal Jordanian Air Force|air force]] intercepts four missiles and one drone launched from Iran. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/3/25/iran-war-live-trump-again-says-talks-underway-12-killed-in-south-tehran (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Kuwait in the 2026 Iran war|2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
****A drone strikes a fuel tank at [[Kuwait International Airport]], causing a fire at the site. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/drone-attack-hits-fuel-tank-kuwait-international-airport-causing-fire-2026-03-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
***According to [[Press TV]], [[Iran]] has rejected a [[United States]] proposal to end the war and sets out five conditions for a [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.intellinews.com/iran-rejects-us-proposal-and-sets-five-conditions-for-ending-war-433678/?source=israel (bne IntelliNews)] [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-israel-trump-lebanon-march-25-2026-be07c54139bcc70672bb33f0773ede6a (AP)]
***A senior Iranian official says that Iran is still reviewing the proposal despite an initial response that was considered "negative". [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/israel-strikes-tehran-trump-says-us-negotiating-end-war-2026-03-25/ (Reuters)]
***[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] states that Iran seeks to end the war "on its own terms" but does not plan to enter negotiations with the U.S. and will continue its current policy. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/564670.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]
***[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Egypt)|Egyptian foreign minister]] [[Badr Abdelatty]] says that [[Egypt]] is ready to host negotiations aimed at ending the Iran war. [https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/middle-east/2026/03/25/egypt-s-foreign-minister-says-country-ready-to-host-any-meetings-related-to-iran (Reuters via Al Arabiya)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Israel]]
***An Iranian [[Cluster munition|cluster bomb]] wounds nine people, including six children and an elderly woman, in [[Bnei Brak]], [[Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/nine-people-wounded-in-bnei-brak-by-iranian-cluster-bomb-munitions/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Iraq in the 2026 Iran war]]
***Seven fighters are killed and 13 others are injured in a strike on a [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] base in [[Al Anbar Governorate]], [[Iraq]]. The attack follows an [[United States Armed Forces|American]] strike on the same base yesterday. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/8/564619/World/Region/Strike-on-western-Iraq-kills-seven-security-person.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]
**Iran says it has received [[military intelligence|intelligence]] that the U.S. and an "unnamed regional country" are planning to invade and capture its [[Kharg Island]] in the [[Persian Gulf]] as thousands of [[United States Marine Corps|U.S. Marines]] are due to arrive in the region in the coming days. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/03/25/iran-war-latest-news-trump-ceasefire-plan-hormuz/ (''The Telegraph'')]

**[[Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***A stray [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] drone strikes a [[power station]] in [[Auvere]], [[Estonia]], while another crashes in [[Latvia]] during a large-scale [[drone attack]] on [[Russia]]. ***A Ukrainian drone strike kills two people in [[Belgorod Oblast]], Russia, according to [[Governor of Belgorod Oblast|Belgorod governor]] [[Vyacheslav Gladkov]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/ukrainian-drones-kill-two-russian-border-region-belgorod-governor-says-2026-03-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[El Fasher massacre]], [[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The Sudan Doctors Network says that [[Rapid Support Forces]] have killed 16 civilians, including three women, in [[El Fasher]], [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/312087#google_vignette (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Operation Southern Spear]]
**[[United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear]]
***The [[United States Southern Command]] (Southcom) says [[United States Armed Forces|its forces]] have struck a [[Illegal drug trade|drug smuggling]] boat in the [[Caribbean Sea]], killing four occupants. This brings the number of alleged [[Narcoterrorism|narcoterrorists]] killed in Operation Southern Spear to 163 since U.S. strikes began. *[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**A ceasefire between [[Afghanistan]] and [[Pakistan]] collapses with resumed cross-border [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] killing two people in [[Kunar Province]], Afghanistan, while [[Afghan Armed Forces|Afghan forces]] claim to have destroyed three [[Pakistan Armed Forces|Pakistani military]] outposts along [[Durand Line|the border]]. Both sides accuse each other of breaking the ceasefire first. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-pakistan-temporary-oause-fighting-ended-19fcf231eb89de69acd0a831144ca7c8 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***[[COSCO Shipping]] resumes new [[container ship]]ment bookings from the [[Far East]] to several [[Arab states of the Persian Gulf|Gulf countries]] after [[Iran]] allowed [[non-belligerent|non-hostile]] vessels to pass through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] since yesterday. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/china-shipping-giant-cosco-says-resumes-bookings-to-some-gulf-countries (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
***[[India]] purchases a shipment of [[liquefied petroleum gas]] from [[Petroleum industry in Iran|Iran]] for the first time since 2019 following a temporary easing of [[United States sanctions against Iran|U.S. sanctions]], with the cargo set to be distributed among [[Public Sector Undertakings in India|state-run]] [[Oil and gas industry in India|fuel companies]], in response to supply disruptions caused by the Strait of Hormuz crisis. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/india-buys-first-iran-lpg-cargo-years-after-us-eases-sanctions-sources-say-2026-03-25/ (Reuters)]
**[[Gold]] [[Gold as an investment|prices]] in [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], rise after a 15-day drop amidst [[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations|potential diplomacy to end the Iran war]]. [https://gulfnews.com/business/retail/dubai-gold-surges-after-15-day-drop-prices-jump-overnight-1.500485538 (''Gulf News'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[International Organization for Migration]] reports that 922 migrants have died or went missing along the "Eastern Route" from the [[Horn of Africa]] to the [[Arabian Peninsula]] in 2025, marking the deadliest year for [[Red Sea]] migration and a significant increase from 2024. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/world/news/deadliest-year-ever-red-sea-migrants-922-deaths-un-4135201 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')]
*At least 26 people are killed, including seven children, 11 others survive and around 13 are reported missing when a [[bus|passenger bus]] carrying around 50 people plunges into the [[Padma River]] in [[Goalanda Upazila]], [[Rajbari District]], [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/18-bodies-recovered-after-bus-plunges-into-bangladeshs-padma-river/3878874 (AA)] [https://english.news.cn/20260326/db6d276e66984adebfe06ccec25638d6/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–North Korea relations]]
**[[Belarus|Belarusian]] [[President of Belarus|president]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] visits [[Pyongyang]], [[North Korea]], to meet with [[Supreme Leader of North Korea|its supreme leader]] [[Kim Jong Un]] in a effort to improve relations between the two countries. [https://apnews.com/article/hungary-cut-gas-supplies-ukraine-russian-oil-dispute-4a8e4c31c5f10b768edba145b9fc1d4e (AP)]
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|prime minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] authorizes [[British Armed Forces|the military]] to board [[Russian shadow fleet]] vessels used by the [[Federal Government of Russia|Russian government]] to evade [[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine|international sanctions]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-authorises-military-board-russian-shadow-fleet-tankers-2026-03-25/ (Reuters)]
*The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations General Assembly|General Assembly]] adopts a [[United Nations resolution|resolution]] proposed by [[Ghana]] recognizing the [[Atlantic slave trade]] as a [[crime against humanity]] and calling for dialogue on [[Reparations for slavery|reparations]], despite opposition and abstentions from [[Western world|Western countries]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/un-adopts-ghanas-slavery-resolution-defying-resistance-us-europe-2026-03-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping]]
**A [[China|Chinese]] [[Judicial system of China|court]] sentences former [[Aviation Industry Corporation of China|Aviation Industry Corporation]] chairperson [[Tan Ruisong]] to [[Capital punishment in China|death]] with a two-year [[Death sentence with reprieve|reprieve]] after convicting him of [[Corruption in China|corruption]]-related offenses, including [[bribery]], [[embezzlement]], and [[insider trading]], during his tenure as chairperson. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/former-chinese-aerospace-executive-handed-suspended-death-sentence-over-2026-03-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mahadev Betting App Case]]
**The [[Enforcement Directorate|Indian enforcement directorate]] says that it has attached {{INRConvert|1700|c|lk=on}} in [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], and has seized villas in the [[Burj Khalifa]] as part of the Mahadev [[Online gambling|online betting]] app money laundering investigation. [https://www.newindianexpress.com/amp/story/nation/2026/Mar/25/ed-attaches-rs-1700-crore-dubai-assets-in-mahadev-betting-app-case-villas-in-burj-khalifa-seized (''The New Indian Express'')]
*[[Terrorism in Kuwait]]
**[[Kuwait]]i authorities arrest six individuals suspected of links to [[Hezbollah]] over an alleged plot to carry out [[assassination]]s targeting [[Government of Kuwait|state officials]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2637682/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*''[[K.G.M. v. Meta et al.]]''
**A [[Juries in the United States|jury]] in [[California]], United States, rules in favor of a woman who sued [[Google]] and [[Meta Platforms]] for her [[Internet addiction disorder|addictions]] to websites [[Instagram]] and [[YouTube]] as a child. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/25/meta-youtube-los-angeles-california-verdict.html (CNBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Kosovan presidential election]]
**[[Kosovo]]'s [[Constitutional Court of Kosovo|Constitutional Court]] rules that [[President of Kosovo|President]] [[Vjosa Osmani]]'s decree to [[Dissolution of parliament|dissolve]] had no legal effect, giving the [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo|Kuvendi]] 34 more days to elect the next president before automatically moving to new elections within 45 days. [https://balkanview.com/kosovo-court-says-president-did-not-breach-constitution-sets-34-day-deadline-to-elect-new-head-of-state/ (''Balkan View'')]
*[[2026 Philippine energy crisis]]
**[[Philippines|Philippine]] [[President of the Philippines|president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] signs into [[Philippine legal codes|law]] a measure allowing the suspension or reduction of [[excise]]s on [[Energy in the Philippines|petroleum products]] when global [[Price of oil|oil prices]] reach a specified threshold, subject to time limits and reporting requirements. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2201258/marcos-signs-bill-suspending-fuel-excise-tax (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*[[2026 Danish general election]]
**After winning her party, the [[Social Democrats (Denmark)|Social Democrats]], a reduced majority in the elections, [[Prime Minister of Denmark|Prime Minister]] [[Mette Frederiksen]] resigns, but is tasked by [[King of Denmark|King]] [[Frederik X]] with leading talks to form a new government. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/03/25/danish-king-tasks-outgoing-pm-mette-frederiksen-with-leading-talks-for-next-government (Euronews)]
